rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: civic and parks - a park is where trees are the point: clumps of 3-5 at the edges and round the seating, open lawn in the middle (zone 154 -> about 100)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The park's eight builder trees go; four come back on their own spots at the edges: one at the west edge by the bougainvillea, one over the bench, two at the east edge by the bike rack (more were over the in-view limit with the blocks round it). The middle of the lawn stays open.

trees.why: the west edge by the bougainvillea, near the picnic table
the park bench at the south edge (1.1 m off): a magnolia over it
the east clump at the lawn's edge
the east clump's second by the bike rack: a queen palm for height at the entrance
